# [STORY] As the project owner, I want a real Scrum-shaped, quality-gated, self-scheduling dev process, so that work stays traceable and the system can run unattended

## User Story
As the project owner
I want a real Scrum-shaped, quality-gated, self-scheduling development process
So that work stays traceable to real issues and the system can keep working the backlog unattended or interactively via AI sessions

## Parent Epic
Parent: #74

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a new issue is created, when it's a Story, then it follows Epic -> Story -> Task shape with Gherkin acceptance criteria, a Story Points estimate, and a Sprint milestone
- [x] Given a task is implemented, when it's committed, then the commit message references the issue number and a commit-msg hook rejects it otherwise
- [x] Given a task is fully verified, when it's pushed, then it lands on `develop`, not directly on `main`
- [x] Given a Story closes, when all its child Tasks are completed, verified on `develop`, and meet the Definition of Done, then `develop` merges into `main` (promoting verified functional increments upon Story completion, verified by merging `develop` to `main` upon closing Story #77)
- [x] Given the scheduled routine fires, when a lock file is checked via `origin/develop`, then it either picks up work if no active lock is present or exits immediately if an unexpired lock exists (visibility mechanism proven across independent clones in Task #111)
